one_line: The paper proposes a conceptual Energy Management System Plug-&-Monitor architecture using an Asset Administration Shell for flexible, reconfigurable Modular Plants in the chemical and pharmaceutical/specialty-chemical industries (batch/recipe-based, not continuous-flow); continuous production is only referenced via a cited aggregation method.
